[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of protein-rich lunch ideas without suggesting chicken or eggs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lunch ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Turkey and Avocado Wrap: Whole wheat wrap with turkey breast, avocado, mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese (approx. 40g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lentil Soup with Quinoa: Cooked lentils with vegetables and spices, served with quinoa and whole grain bread (approx. 20g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Tuna Salad Sandwich: Canned tuna with low-fat mayo, onions, and celery on whole grain bread with carrot sticks (approx. 35g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Greek Yogurt Parfait: Greek yogurt layered with berries, granola, and sliced almonds, topped with protein powder (approx. 25g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Veggie and Bean Chili: Chili made with black beans, kidney beans, and vegetables, served with whole grain crackers (approx. 25g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Grilled Salmon with Quinoa and Broccoli: Pan-seared salmon with quinoa and steamed broccoli (approx. 35g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Chickpea and Spinach Salad: Mixed greens with chickpeas, spinach, cherry tomatoes, and lemon-tahini dressing (approx. 20g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Protein-Packed Smoothie: Blend of Greek yogurt, frozen berries, spinach, almond milk, and protein powder (approx. 30g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Turkey Meatball Sub: Whole wheat sub with turkey meatballs, marinara sauce, and mozzarella cheese (approx. 30g protein).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Edamame and Mushroom Stir-Fry: Stir-fried edamame, mushrooms, and bell peppers in soy sauce with brown rice (approx. 20g protein).
